mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level is not associated with positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5% and rising > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 3.5% AND UNRATE > 4.5% AND UNRATE rising > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS>3.5% AND UNRATE>4.5% AND UNRATE rising) does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates improving economic conditions and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST level is not associated with positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1000.0 does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) and retail sales (RSAFS < 450000.0) signals a severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (INDPRO<100.0 AND RSAFS<450000.0) does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic growth regimes (INDPRO > 110.0), industrial production growth signals robust corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 110.0 does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
